source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Distillation Process, printed as 15.2.1 with Figures 15.6 and 15.7, pages 328-329.

blocks.text: Simple distillation solution se solvent alag karti hai. 100 cm3 samandari pani lein aur simple distillation ka apparatus lagayein (distilling flask, condenser aur receiving flask), liquid ke uchhalne (bumping) se bachne ke liye chand boiling chips dalte hue aur apparatus ko hawa-band karte hue taake bukharat na niklein. Flask ko Bunsen burner se halka garam karein aur condenser ke gird thanda pani aahista ghoomne dein. Pani (ya alcohol) apna boiling point aane par bhaap banta hai, us ke bukharat condenser se guzarte hain, aur ghoomta pani unhen wapas liquid mein condense karta hai: distillate, jo receiving flask mein jama hota hai. Distillation flask mein bache ajza mil kar residue hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan likhti hai 'Set up the apparatus as shown in the Figure 15.5'. Lekin Figure 15.5 crystallization ke marahil ki tasveer hai, distillation ki nahi. Kitab mein simple distillation ke apparatus ki koi alag tasveer nahi; Figure 15.7 fractional distillation ka set-up dikhati hai, jis mein fractionating column hata dein to simple distillation ka apparatus ban jata hai.

Do milne wale liquids ko is tarah alag karna fractional distillation hai, jo sirf tab kamyab hai jab boiling points taqreeban 25 degrees C mukhtalif hon. Distillation column, sheeshe ka column jo bukharat condense karne ki satah barhane ke liye sheeshe ke moti (glass beads) se bhara hai, mixture ko boiling point ke mutabiq ajza mein alag karta hai (Figure 15.7).

blocks.alt: Thermometer reading aur waqt (time) ka graph: curve oopar jati hai, 78 degrees C par seedhi rehti hai (ethanol distil hota hai), phir oopar ja kar 100 degrees C par seedhi ho jati hai (pani distil hota hai).
blocks.caption: Figure 15.6: Ethanol / pani ke mixture ki fractional distillation (kitab ki Figure 15.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Graph ki do seedhi (flat) jagahen boiling points hain. Jab tak ethanol ban kar nikal raha hai, thermometer 78 degrees C par ruka rehta hai; ethanol khatam hone par darja hararat barhti hai aur 100 degrees C par pani distil hota hai. Isi waqt receiving flask badla jata hai.

blocks.alt: Fractional distillation ka apparatus: shole par distilling flask, us ke oopar fractionating column aur thermometer, phir condenser jis mein thanda pani neeche wale sire se dakhil hota aur oopar wale sire se nikalta hai, aur conical flask mein distillate.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.7: Fractional distillation ka setup (kitab ki Figure 15.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer mein 'Cold water in' condenser ke oopar wale sire (flask ki taraf) par aur 'Water out' neeche wale sire par dikhaya gaya hai. Yeh ulta hai: thanda pani hamesha condenser ke neeche wale sire se dakhil hota hai aur oopar wale sire se nikalta hai, taake jacket poori pani se bhari rahe aur bukharat (vapour) behtar thandi ho. Hum ne sahih rukh banaya hai.

Jab ethyl alcohol aur pani ka mixture garam kiya jaye to alcohol pehle distil hoti hai kyunke us ka boiling point, 78 degrees C, pani ke 100 degrees C se kam hai; jab tak alcohol distil hoti hai thermometer 78 degrees C par rehta hai. Jaise hi darja hararat 78 degrees C se oopar barhne lage receiving flask naya laga diya jata hai; jab thermometer 100 degrees C tak pohnche to pani ubalta hai aur condense ho kar doosre distillate ke taur par jama hota hai, to dono ajza khalis milte hain (Figure 15.6). Qudrati petroleum fuels ke taur par istemal hone wale bohat se compounds ka mixture hai, jaise petrol, diesel, kerosene aur furnace oil, jin ke boiling points bohat mukhtalif nahi; yeh fractionating column mein fractional distillation se fractions ke taur par alag kiye jate hain.

blocks.caption: Simple ke muqable fractional distillation

wahi jama sheeshe ke motiyon wala fractionating column
ethanol (78 degrees C) aur pani (100 degrees C); petroleum fractions

blocks.prompt: Fractionating column ka kya kaam hai, aur dono liquids ke boiling points taqreeban 25 degrees C mukhtalif kyun hone chahiye (exercise Q.2e; MCQ VII, VIII)?
blocks.explanation: Sheeshe ke moti bari satah dete hain jis par uthte bukharat bar bar condense aur dobara bhaap bante hain; har cycle bukharat ko zyada udne wale juz se bharpoor karta hai, to sirf kam ubalne wala liquid oopar aur condenser tak pohnchta hai. Agar boiling points bohat qareeb hon to bukharat mein dono liquids itne zyada hote hain ke saada column unhen alag nahi kar sakta aur distillate mixture hota hai.

items: Simple distillation: boiling chips, hawa-band apparatus, halki garmi, pani se thanda condenser; distillate jama, residue rukta hai. Fractional: sheeshe ke motiyon wala column; ethanol 78 degrees C par distil (thermometer theher-ta hai), darja hararat barhne par receiver badlein, pani 100 degrees C par; petroleum fractions.
